findings.affected_area: compiled module admission and PE rebasing
findings.caveat: A raw numeric-range rejection can produce false positives for integer constants whose value happens to equal an image VA. Admission should use typed IR or equivalent address-bearing semantics, with any exception explicit and audited.
findings.description: Compiled code and data containing an absolute image address could be emitted without a COFF relocation or HIGHLOW entry. Such bytes remain fixed at the preferred image base and become invalid after rebasing.

reproduction.compiled_c: typedef int (__cdecl *fn)(int); __declspec(noinline) int changed(int x) { return ((fn)0x401020)(x); } void *absolute_pointer = (void*)0x401020;
observed: .text bytes b820104000ffe0 contained 0x00401020 with no COFF relocation
.data bytes 20104000 contained 0x00401020 with no COFF relocation
returned HIGHLOW site list was empty

findings.failure_observed_before_fix: The compiler receipt recorded the clang executable but omitted loaded shared objects including libclang-cpp.so.21.1 and libLLVM.so.21.1.
fix: Run fresh compiler invocations with the ELF loader file trace enabled.
Resolve and read the loaded shared-object closure.
Require the discovered closure to remain deterministic across the checked invocations.
Add each dependency to observed inputs, content-addressed snapshots and the compiler receipt.
findings.integration_note: The parent subsequently owns the final receipt contract using IR/object invocations, runtime_libraries and separate ELF-interpreter handling.
findings.status: fixed in worker-owned implementation; parent owns final IR/interpreter integration

worker_receipt_field.name: elf_dependencies
worker_receipt_field.shape: list of objects with absolute path and sha256

findings.failure_observed_before_fix: Input object order .rdata$Z, .rdata$A, .rdata$M, .rdata was emitted in object-table order, while a genuine PE linker emitted .rdata, .rdata$A, .rdata$M, .rdata$Z.
fix: Place an unsuffixed section before its $ subsections.
Sort subsection suffixes lexicographically by their original encoded bytes.
Keep equal suffixes stable in source object-table order.
Preserve original COFF section indexes and calculate symbol-index addresses from the reordered placement map.
